exact_title: Effects of Dapagliflozin on 24-Hour Glycemic Control in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes: A Randomized Controlled Trial

visual_strategy.screenshot_note: Main PDF screenshot retrieval was attempted but failed with web cache-miss errors; parsed PDF text/captions and all supplied supplementary PDFs provided sufficient structured reconstruction for the selected representation.

coverage_decision: All 3 main figures, 3 main tables, 5 supplementary figures, and 4 supplementary tables were reconciled. Pure reference bibliography was not atomized.

visual_inventory.title: Demographics and Baseline Characteristics
visual_inventory.key_content: Overall and background-therapy-stratum baseline demographics and glycemic characteristics; treatment arms were broadly balanced while insulin-stratum participants had more advanced disease characteristics.

visual_inventory.title: Overall changes from baseline
visual_inventory.key_content: 24-h mean glucose, MADz 24-h profile comparison, and time in glucose ranges for overall ITT population.

visual_inventory.title: Metformin and insulin stratum 24-h glucose changes
visual_inventory.key_content: Stratum-specific 24-h mean glucose and MADz profile changes; descriptive/nominal subgroup evidence only.

visual_inventory.title: Time in glucose ranges by background-therapy stratum
visual_inventory.key_content: Change in percentages of time in glycemic ranges for metformin and insulin strata.

visual_inventory.title: Key Secondary End Points
visual_inventory.key_content: 2-h PPG, FPG, HbA1c, coefficient of variation, HBGI, and time 70–140 mg/dL; includes explicit stratum-inference caution.

visual_inventory.title: Overview of Adverse Events
visual_inventory.key_content: AEs, TEAEs, UTI, SAEs, discontinuations, and deaths in safety population.

visual_inventory.title: Study flow chart
visual_inventory.key_content: Trial timing and CGM/meal-test flow; source caption supplied in Drive.

visual_inventory.title: Study disposition
visual_inventory.key_content: 100 randomized; 97 completed with adequate lead-in and week-4 CGM data.

visual_inventory.title: Overall 24-h glucose profiles at baseline and week 4
visual_inventory.key_content: MADz comparison of dapagliflozin and placebo across time of day in overall population.

visual_inventory.title: Metformin-stratum 24-h glucose profiles
visual_inventory.key_content: MADz comparison across time of day for metformin stratum.

visual_inventory.title: Insulin-stratum 24-h glucose profiles
visual_inventory.key_content: MADz comparison across time of day for insulin stratum.

visual_inventory.title: Antidiabetes Medications in the Insulin Stratum
visual_inventory.key_content: Distribution of insulin and OAD regimen combinations among 52 insulin-stratum participants.

visual_inventory.title: Time Spent in Plasma Glucose Ranges
visual_inventory.key_content: Baseline and week-4 time >180, 70–180, and <70 mg/dL overall and by stratum.

visual_inventory.title: Key Secondary End Points
visual_inventory.key_content: Fructosamine, MAGE, distance traveled, and 24-h glucose SD overall and by stratum; explicit warning against stratum treatment inference.

visual_inventory.title: Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events by System Organ Class and Preferred Term
visual_inventory.key_content: Detailed TEAE breakdown by MedDRA v17.1 for dapagliflozin, placebo, and overall safety population.
